author: Jesse Garcia
title: Emmet Sheehan grinds out five for win vs Padres
desc: Emmet Sheehan allowed one earned run on two hits and two walks while striking out five over five innings in Sunday's 4-2 win over the Padres.
impact: After the win, he now has a 5.08 ERA and 1.27 WHIP with a 4-5 record across 15 starts. Sheehan turned in a much needed positive outing and he will look to carry that into his next start, a scheduled rematch with the Padres.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Riley O'Brien slams door for save No. 20
desc: Riley O'Brien struck out one batter in a scoreless appearance to earn the save in Sunday's 2-1 win over the Marlins.
impact: After Sunday's win, O'Brien now has a 3.93 ERA and 1.17 WHIP with 20 saves, four blown saves and one hold across 34 appearances. This was O'Brien's first appearance in six days, but he remained sharp to lock down the save.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Kyle Leahy grinds out five for a narrow win
desc: Kyle Leahy allowed one earned run on two hits and three walks while striking out five over five innings in Sunday's 2-1 win over the Marlins.
impact: After the win, he now has a 4.09 ERA and 1.48 WHIP to go with a 6-4 record across 16 starts. This marks the third straight outing in which Leahy has allowed three earned runs or less. He will look to continue that success in his next outing against the Cubs.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: JJ Wetherholt Chips In, Swipes Bag in 2-1 Win
desc: JJ Wetherholt went 2-for-4 in a win over the Marlins with one stolen base and two strikeouts.
impact: Through 77 games this season, he's slashing .265 with 12 home runs, and nine stolen bases. The rookie is hitting .290 with three runs scored and three RBI over his last seven games.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Bryan Torres plays hero despite shaky season line
desc: Bryan Torres went 1-for-3 in Sunday's 2-1 win over the Marlins with a home run, one run scored and two RBI.
impact: Through 20 games, Torres is batting .235 with three homers, seven RBI, seven runs scored, and one stolen base. Torres has played sparingly for the Cardinals, limiting his long-term fantasy value.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Alex Lange locks down save as Royals edge White Sox
desc: Alex Lange threw a scoreless frame on 10 pitches to earn the save in Sunday's 5-4 win over the White Sox.
impact: After Sunday's win, Lange now has a 4.95 ERA and 1.49 WHIP with eight saves and one hold across 35 appearances. Lange needed a bounce back outing after allowing five earned runs and only recording one out in his first outing of the series.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Linder Avila labors through four in Royals' one-run win
desc: Luinder Avila allowed four earned runs on six hits and three walks while striking out four over four innings in Sunday's 5-4 win over the White Sox.
impact: After the outing, Avila now owns a 5.40 ERA and 1.67 WHIP with a 3-3 record, 8.3 K/9 and a 1.43 K:BB across 16 outings. Avila continues to struggle with command and will need to work on that in his next outing against the Phillies.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Kameron Misner swipes a bag despite quiet day at the plate
desc: Kameron Misner went 1-for-4 in a win over the White Sox with one stolen base and one strikeout.
impact: After Sunday's win over Chicago, Misner is hitting .281 with three stolen bases, four RBI and a 0.273 wOBA across 13 games. Misner has not played enough to currently hold any fantasy value.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Starling Marte chips in two hits and a swipe in one-run win
desc: Starling Marte went 2-for-5 in Sunday's 5-4 win over the White Sox with one run scored, one stolen base and one strikeout.
impact: Through 38 games, Marte is slashing .266/.330/.340 with one home run, seven RBI, 11 runs scored, and one steal. The 37-year-old veteran is 7-for-23 with six runs scored in his last seven games.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Lane Thomas chips in two hits, swipes bag in tight win
desc: Lane Thomas went 2-for-5 in a 5-4 win over the White Sox with a run scored, an RBI and a stolen base.
impact: Through 70 games, he's slashing .216/.329/.335 with five homers, 23 RBI, 20 runs scored and four steals alongside a .301 wOBA. Thomas' bat has gone quiet as of late, hitting just .193 over his last 15 games.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Carter Jensen racks up three hits, drives in two vs. White Sox
desc: Carter Jensen went 3-for-5 in Sunday's win over the White Sox with a double, two RBI and one strikeout. T
impact: Through 78 games, Jensen is slashing .251/.317/.438 with 11 homers, 45 RBI, 39 runs scored, and 17 doubles. Jensen has a .371 average, with three home runs, and 14 RBI over his last 15 games.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Kyle Bradish's wildness sinks Orioles in loss
desc: Kyle Bradish allowed three earned runs on one hit and five walks while striking out two over four innings in Sunday's loss to the Nationals.
impact: After the defeat, he now has a 3.77 ERA and 1.45 WHIP with a 5-8 record across 17 starts. Bradish struggled with control all game, allowing a season-high five walks in the process. He is currently slated to take on the Reds in his next start.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Colton Cowser chips in two hits and a swipe in loss
desc: Colton Cowser went 2-for-3 in a loss to the Nationals with one run scored and one stolen base.
impact: After Sunday's loss, Cowser is batting .235 with eight home runs, 27 RBI, 27 runs scored, and three stolen bases across 74 games. Cowser is hitting .300 with two runs scored and four RBI over his last seven games.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Jackson Holliday Pops One, But O's Come Up Short
desc: Jackson Holliday went 1-for-3 in Sunday's 6-4 loss to the Nationals with a home run, one run scored and two RBI.
impact: After Sunday's loss to Washington, Holliday is batting .204 with five home runs, 14 RBI, 15 runs scored and three stolen bases across 33 games. Holliday ended the series with Washington going 2-for-7.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Pete Alonso goes yard, but O's fall 6-4
desc: Pete Alonso went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Nationals with a home run, one run scored, two RBI and one strikeout.
impact: Alonso is batting .252 with 19 home runs, 58 RBI, 53 runs scored and two stolen bases across 85 games. The Polar Bear is heating up at the plate, hitting .333, with two home runs and nine RBI over his last seven games.
